timing: Postrelease different-method verification, after the original prerelease derivation freeze and complete printed-proof reading. No additional independent-check event.

method_comparison.old: The pinned SymPy routine forms the 64 commutator equations and finds a nullspace by row reduction. The prerelease Fraction routine also uses elimination, so that centralizer calculation alone is not a different algorithm.
method_comparison.new: Construct the 16 by 16 integral Gram matrix G=A^t A of the 64 by 16 commutator matrix, multiply powers and compute all 16 exact traces, then obtain the characteristic coefficients by Newton identities. This program makes no elimination, linear-solver, nullspace or numerical-eigenvalue call.
method_comparison.rank_proof: The characteristic polynomial has a zero of exact order two: its coefficient of z^2 is nonzero and its last two coefficients vanish. G is real symmetric, hence diagonalizable, so rank(G)=14. The exact identity v^tGv=sum_j(Av)_j^2 proves ker(G)=ker(A). Rational and real ranks of an integer matrix agree because the nonzero minors are the same. Direct substitution verifies the two independent generators I,E41 for homology and I,E14 for cohomology; dimension two makes these bases.
method_comparison.integral_lattice_method: The original prerelease explicit coordinate parameterizations, norm-column generation and quotient maps already verify the integral fixed/norm/image lattices by a method distinct from the old Hermite/Smith reductions.
